title: Deep Learning Paper Reproduction
content: dl-paper-repro is a Cursor plugin and CLI system for evidence-driven reproduction of deep learning papers. Features staged reproduction gates, GitHub repository discovery, hardware-fit auditing, and machine-readable evidence chains.

title: Quick Start Guide
content: Run doctor to check environment, then start a project with python reproctl.py start --project . --plan output/PAPER_PLAN.md --mode strict

title: Core Commands
content: start doctor status resume stop verify version init can-launch launch run-short-loop report update-gate record-experiment update-experiment get-experiments human-checkpoint check-principles integrity-check orchestrator storage

title: Feature Status
content: Staged reproduction gates L0-L3, evidence-driven verification, SQLite state store, automated workflows, storage governance, GPU detection, short-loop validation tests

title: start Command
content: python scripts/reproctl.py start --project PATH --plan PLAN [--mode MODE] [--dry-run] [--expected-cuda VERSION]. Bootstraps and starts the project with unified entry point.

title: doctor Command
content: python scripts/reproctl.py doctor --project PATH [--plan PLAN] [--expected-cuda VERSION]. Runs preflight checks without state mutation. Exit codes: 0 for PASS/WARNING, 3 for FAIL.

title: status Command
content: python scripts/reproctl.py status --project PATH. Shows project state, lock status, and plan hash. Returns JSON output.

title: resume Command
content: python scripts/reproctl.py resume --project PATH. Resumes an interrupted project. Exit codes: 0 success, 2 config error, 4 already running, 8 recovery failed.

title: stop Command
content: python scripts/reproctl.py stop --project PATH. Gracefully stops the project and clears the lock.

title: verify Command
content: python scripts/reproctl.py verify --project PATH. Verifies the startup evidence chain including startup_state.json and doctor_report.json.

title: version Command
content: python scripts/reproctl.py version. Prints plugin and CLI version in JSON format.

title: init Command
content: python scripts/reproctl.py init [--paper URL] [--target METRIC]. Initializes a new reproduction project.

title: can-launch Command
content: python scripts/reproctl.py can-launch [--mode MODE]. Checks if full training can be launched. Modes: strict_repro, optimized_repro_safe, experimental_fast.

title: launch Command
content: python scripts/reproctl.py launch [--mode MODE] [--seed SEED] [--epochs EPOCHS] [--config CONFIG]. Launches full training with gate enforcement.

title: run-short-loop Command
content: python scripts/reproctl.py run-short-loop [--level LEVEL] [--config CONFIG] [--overfit-steps STEPS] [--epochs EPOCHS]. Runs short-loop validation tests L0-L3: smoke test, overfit test, mini-loop test, checkpoint resume test.

title: orchestrator Commands
content: orchestrator run, pause, continue, stop, status, events, next, approve, reject, daemon, migrate, backup, restore, integrity-check, rollback-version. Persistent controller for long-running tasks.

title: storage Commands
content: storage status, plan-cleanup, cleanup, apply. Disk policy and retention management for managing disk space during training.

title: System Architecture
content: dl-paper-repro has a three-layer architecture: CLI Layer (reproctl.py dispatcher), Startup Subsystem (preflight, lock, recovery), and Orchestrator Subsystem (task scheduling, execution, monitoring).

title: Component Architecture
content: reproctl.py dispatcher routes to startup/cli.py (start, doctor, status, resume, stop, verify, version) or orchestrator/cli.py (run, pause, continue, status, events, approve, reject, daemon).

title: StateStore (SQLite)
content: StateStore uses SQLite with WAL mode for task state machine. Tables: metadata, tasks, approvals, events, heartbeats.

title: Task State Machine
content: Task states: PENDING, READY, RUNNING, VERIFYING, PASS, FAIL, RETRY_WAIT, WAITING_APPROVAL, APPROVED, REJECTED. Valid transitions enforce dependency ordering.

title: Gate System
content: Gates 0-5: gate_0_paper_audit, gate_1_preflight, gate_2_short_loop, gate_3_parity, gate_4_full_training, gate_5_evidence. Each gate must pass before proceeding.

title: Exit Codes
content: Exit codes: 0 success, 1 failure/parameter error, 2 config error, 3 doctor fail, 4 already running, 5 invalid plan, 6 task failed, 7 task blocked, 8 resume failed, 9 security blocked, 10 internal error.

title: Configuration Fields
content: mode (strict/safe/fast), log_level (DEBUG/INFO/WARNING/ERROR), expected_cuda, auto_proceed, human_checkpoint, automation (safe-auto/auto/manual), retention, disk_policy, permissions.

title: Retention Policy
content: raw_data (never_delete/delete_after_days), best_checkpoint (keep/delete_after_days), intermediate_checkpoints (integer default 3), failed_run_logs, generated_plots, cache.

title: Disk Policy
content: warning_free_gb (default 50), stop_free_gb (default 20), emergency_free_gb (default 10). Controls when storage warnings and stops are triggered.

title: Permissions
content: network_access (default true), github_read (default true), github_write (default false), training_execute (default true).

title: Environment Variables
content: REPRO_FAKE_GPU=0 simulates no GPU, REPRO_FAKE_CUDA sets CUDA version, REPRO_FAKE_DISK_FREE sets available disk space in bytes.

title: Quick Start Commands
content: doctor, start, status, resume, stop, verify - the seven essential commands for project lifecycle management.

title: Workflow Flow
content: doctor -> start -> run orchestrator -> monitor status -> pause/continue -> stop -> verify. Complete project lifecycle from initialization to evidence verification.

title: Doctor Failures
content: View doctor_report.json for details. Common failures: cuda_match (install correct CUDA), disk_space (free up space), security (remove secrets), leftover_procs (stop old instances).

title: Lock Conflicts
content: Check run.lock file, verify PID exists with ps, remove stale locks with rm .repro/run.lock or run stop command.

title: Recovery Failures
content: Check execution_state.json for corruption, delete if needed, run start --dry-run to reinitialize. Use orchestrator events to see what happened.

title: SQLite Locked
content: Remove WAL files: rm .repro/execution/state.sqlite3-wal state.sqlite3-shm. Restart orchestrator with stop and daemon start commands.

title: GPU Issues
content: Check CUDA with torch.cuda.is_available(), verify nvidia-smi works. Set REPRO_FAKE_GPU=0 to skip GPU checks in test environments.

title: Approval Workflow Stuck
content: Use orchestrator status to see pending approvals, then orchestrator approve apr_xxxxx or orchestrator reject apr_xxxxx --reason TEXT.

title: Startup vs Orchestrator
content: Startup manages project initialization, preflight checks, and lock management. Orchestrator handles task scheduling, execution, and monitoring of long-running jobs.

title: strict vs optimized
content: strict mode uses no optimizations for exact reproduction. optimized mode enables AMP and DDP but requires passing gate_3_parity first. Both allow ±0.5pp tolerance.

title: Gate System
content: Six gates ensure quality gates before proceeding: paper audit, preflight, short loop (L0-L3), parity check, full training, and evidence verification.

title: AMP
content: Automatic Mixed Precision - automatically switches between fp16 and fp32 to improve training speed and reduce memory usage.

title: DDP
content: Distributed Data Parallel - multi-GPU training method that distributes batches across GPUs.

title: Gate
content: Staged checkpoint that must pass before proceeding to next phase. Gates 0-5 cover paper audit through evidence verification.

title: L0-L3
content: Short loop test levels: L0 smoke test (single batch forward+backward), L1 overfit test, L2 mini-loop test, L3 checkpoint resume test.

title: WAL
content: Write-Ahead Logging - SQLite journal mode that improves concurrent read performance.

title: safe-auto
content: Default automation strategy that pauses for human approval on critical decisions.

title: Automation Modes
content: safe-auto (default, requires approval), manual (all tasks require approval), unattended (no waiting, auto timeout).

title: Daemon Mode
content: orchestrator daemon start/stop/status controls background process. Writes heartbeat to controller.heartbeat file.

title: Approval Workflow
content: Tasks with requires_approval=true pause for human review. Use orchestrator approve apr_xxxxx or orchestrator reject apr_xxxxx.

title: Initialize Project
content: mkdir my-repro && cd my-repro && git init && python reproctl.py init --paper URL --target 'Table 3, mIoU'

title: Discover Repositories
content: Use /repro-discover command to find candidate GitHub repositories. Evaluates official status, stars, training scripts, and license.

title: Run Doctor
content: python reproctl.py doctor --project . --expected-cuda 12.0. Checks Python, dependencies, GPU, CUDA, disk space, security, and permissions.

title: Start Project
content: python reproctl.py start --project . --plan output/PAPER_PLAN.md --mode strict. Bootstraps and acquires lock.

title: Assess State
content: Check status, doctor_report.json, orchestrator status, and event logs to understand current project state before resuming.

title: Cleanup
content: Stop old instances with stop and orchestrator daemon stop. Remove stale locks if PID no longer exists.

title: Resume
content: python reproctl.py resume --project . or orchestrator daemon start with --resume flag to continue interrupted work.

title: Backup
content: orchestrator backup --project . [--include-checkpoints] [--output-dir PATH]. Creates snapshot of state.sqlite3, startup directory, and experiment tracker.

title: Restore
content: orchestrator restore --project . --snapshot SNAPSHOT_ID [--output-dir PATH]. Restores from backup snapshot.

title: Migration
content: orchestrator migrate --project . [--check-only] [--target-version VERSION]. Checks and applies state migrations for version upgrades.

title: Storage Governance
content: storage status, plan-cleanup, cleanup, apply. Manage disk space with automatic cleanup of intermediate checkpoints.

title: Secrets Redaction
content: SecretsRedactor detects and redacts tokens, passwords, API keys. Patterns: Bearer <token>, password=*, token=*, Authorization:, AWS_SECRET*, OPENAI_API_KEY*.

title: File Permissions
content: chmod 600 for run.lock and state.sqlite3, chmod 700 for .repro directory. Prevents unauthorized access.

title: 5 Principles
content: require_official_first, require_strict_mode, require_raw_metrics, require_provenance, require_reproducibility. check-principles validates these.

title: GPU Requirements
content: Minimum: 8GB VRAM, compute 7.0+, CUDA 11.0+. Recommended: 16-24GB VRAM, compute 8.0+, CUDA 12.0+, 2-4 GPUs.

title: Performance Optimization
content: Enable AMP with --amp flag, use DDP with torchrun, gradient checkpointing, reduce batch size for OOM issues.

title: Monitoring
content: training_monitor.py for real-time metrics, nvidia-smi dmon -s u for GPU utilization, check task logs in .repro/execution/tasks/.

title: Research Crawler
content: research_crawler.py --query QUERY [--max-results N] [--language LANG] [--stars-min N]. Searches GitHub for candidate repositories.

title: Discover Command
content: /repro-discover cursor command prompts for paper URL or keywords, then searches GitHub for related repositories.

title: Repository Evaluation
content: Evaluates is_official (high weight), stars, has_train, has_readme, license, last_commit. /repro-contract shows comparison for selection.

title: Unit Tests
content: pytest tests/unit/ for StateStore, Doctor, Scheduler tests. Use fixtures for sample_plan.yaml and sample_state.json.

title: Integration Tests
content: pytest tests/integration/ for startup and orchestrator flow tests. Tests verify command outputs and state transitions.

title: CI Configuration
content: GitHub Actions workflow with pytest, pytest-cov. Coverage targets: StateStore 90%, Doctor 80%, Scheduler 80%, CLI 70%.

title: Debugging
content: Enable DEBUG logging with --log-level DEBUG. Check startup.log, daemon.log, and task logs in .repro/execution/tasks/.

title: Doctor Failures
content: View .repro/startup/doctor_report.json for FAIL details. Common: gpu (install CUDA), cuda_match (use --expected-cuda), disk_space (free space), security (remove secrets).

title: Lock Issues
content: EXIT_ALREADY_RUNNING:4 - check run.lock, verify PID exists with ps, stop old instance or rm run.lock.

title: SQLite Locked
content: database is locked - rm state.sqlite3-wal and state.sqlite3-shm, restart orchestrator.

title: Plugin Structure
content: .cursor-plugin/plugin.json, commands/ for cursor commands, docs/, schemas/, scripts/ (core), skills/, templates/, tests/.

title: Runtime Structure
content: .repro/ (config, state, locks, audit), primary/ (main repo), reference/, experiments/, output/ (PAPER_PLAN, manuscript, figures).
